cover.prompt: Inside the Tholos of Schedia: looking across the open circular floor paved in alternating white marble and dark limestone spirals, six fluted columns carrying timber rafters, and stone benches along the red-painted drum; through the open porch doorway beyond, the blue bay shines under golden afternoon light.

r.prompt: liskovia sits writing at her bench by the wall, and tholos-runner crosses the floor towards the door.

tholos.prompt: The Tholos of Schedia on its paved terrace above the bay: a round civic hall of dressed honey limestone under a conical red-tiled roof with a lantern, with a painted meander band under the eaves and a two-column Doric porch before its open timber doors, overlooking the harbor and the sea.

r.prompt: okios and liskovia walk across the terrace towards the porch, and tholos-runner runs out of the open door.

seal.prompt: Close on a stone stand beside a bench in the Tholos: modular bronze signet seals of Schedia, wax tablets with cut seals, and multiple red wax seal impressions assembled together into a verified bundle beside a stylus.

r.prompt: Seen from above: the hands of tholos-runner tie three sealed wax tablets together into one bundle on the stand.

benches.prompt: Looking across the open floor of alternating Pentelic marble and dark Eleusinian limestone lozenges in the Tholos towards the marble benches along the red-painted wall, with bronze seal kits and wax tablets on their stone stands.

r.prompt: okios sits at the nearest bench writing on a scroll, and tholos-runner walks along the wall past him towards the far benches.
r.others: two more legislators in white, each alone at a bench further along the wall, writing on a scroll.
